title: OfficePress product promise
note: Ready-made tools for back-office work; incremental adoption, interoperability and company control. Not a licensing or deployment claim.

title: OfficePress product catalogue
note: Thirty intended apps: 28 products in four branded families and two platform apps. Meaning is not evidence of deployment.

title: Shared app experience and maintained proof READMEs
type: Project design and bounded proof evidence
note: Common frame, settings, workflow modules and preferences. Also inspected proofs/app-shell/README.md and proofs/common-components/README.md at d8ade68. No product-by-product production audit performed.

title: OfficePress brand identity and supplied visual kit
note: Family colours, current product marks, and archived Inbox board design reference. Design/sample records do not prove live capability.

title: Founder clarification on pre-seed stage and active Shoppable pilots
note: Six free app pilots at one organisation, Shoppable Business, reported actively used in exchange for feedback. Six URLs supplied. No independent usage audit; paid conversion, active users and company wide revenue are not established.

title: US Census Bureau Small Business Week 2026
note: 5.58 million firms with 1 to 499 employees, Business Dynamics Statistics. Used instead of a different SBA series to avoid mixing US counts.

title: UK business population estimates 2026 statistical release
note: Table A: about 1.472 million employers. Includes large firms. Official statistics in development; rounded figure used.

title: Canada Key Small Business Statistics 2025
note: Approximately 1.10 million employer businesses, including about 1.08 million with 1 to 99 employees. Entire Canada is an upper-bound geography; not every business is an English-language prospect.

title: Australian business counts July 2022 to June 2026
note: 996203 employing businesses. Latest-release URL may later advance to another reference period.

title: New Zealand business demography February 2026
note: 161560 enterprises with one or more paid employees. Includes large enterprises; economically significant enterprise coverage.

title: General Atlantic follow-on investment in Odoo
note: Secondary minority stake acquisition at EUR7 billion company valuation; over 170000 paying customers and presence in 180 countries stated by investor. Not fresh primary capital or OfficePress valuation.

title: Odoo EUR500 million secondary transaction
note: EUR500 million secondary transaction at EUR5 billion company valuation. Historical observation, not current quotation.

title: Zoho One pricing
note: Observed Standard all-employee USD37 and flexible-user USD90 per user/month on annual licensing; page flags first-year terms. Region, promotions, renewal and taxes must be checked. Standard advertises 50+ apps.

title: ERPNext pricing and hosting
note: Free open-source software, self-hosting option, Frappe Cloud site hosting from USD5/month and separate implementation. Starting infrastructure price is not an equivalent managed suite total cost.

title: Microsoft 365 business plans and pricing
note: Observed US Business Basic with Teams USD7/user/month, paid yearly; Standard with Copilot USD23.50. Different bundles, annual commitments and usage terms apply.

title: monday work management pricing
note: Observed 10-seat annual selection: Basic USD9, Standard USD12, Pro USD19 per seat/month; page displays AI credits and promotional adjustments. These are work-management products, not suite-equivalent scope.

title: HubSpot Customer Platform pricing
note: Observed Starter advertised USD7/seat/month promo versus USD20 reference; Professional starts USD1300/month with six seats and credit terms. Geography and limited-release offerings may differ.

title: Completed Zendesk acquisition
note: Completed all-cash acquisition described as approximately USD10.2 billion company transaction value. Historical control transaction; not directly comparable to minority financing.

title: Wix announces Base44 acquisition
note: Headline initial consideration approximately USD80 million plus earnouts through 2029. Public financial reporting uses different accounting measures; do not call the headline cash paid or a clean valuation multiple.

title: Wix 2025 Form 20 F
note: Reports approximately USD92 million total Base44 acquisition consideration including contingent consideration. Used to explain why acquisition headlines and accounting consideration are not interchangeable.

title: SaaS Capital Index methodology
note: Uses annualized current run-rate revenue, excludes mixed-revenue businesses and certain very small-customer models. No private OfficePress multiple inferred from the index.
